Model: Gemini 4 Argon (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon, docs/generate-content/latest-model, docs/generate-content/long-decode; cookbook Get_started_Generate_Content 'What's new in Gemini 4 Argon'). What differs from 3.8 Flash in the response: long decode. A single request stops at a per-request cap (32,768 output tokens non-streaming, 65,536 streaming, thinking included) with finishReason CONTINUATION and a candidate continuationToken; a stream also carries checkpoint continuationTokens on intermediate chunks with no finishReason; and a request whose own maxOutputTokens runs out stops with MAX_TOKENS and still carries a continuationToken (max_tokens_continuation: all 4096 tokens spent thinking, no parts). Argon thinks by default (medium), so thoughtsTokenCount and a signed final part appear without includeThoughts; it rejects thinkingBudget and minimal. stream_error is the mid-stream error chunk go-genai raises as an APIError; the adapter ends the stream with it as the stream's error.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap G2: the long-decode continuationToken is dropped. The gateway neither follows it (the official SDKs do by default) nor lets a client send it back, so output past the per-request cap (32,768 tokens non-streaming, 65,536 streaming) or past a too-small max_tokens is unreachable through /v1/chat/completions
known gap G12: Gemini's responseId is dropped and the canonical id is a gateway-generated gen-<nanos>, so a response cannot be traced back to Google (support cases, logs)

known gap G13: the per-modality prompt token breakdown (TEXT / IMAGE / AUDIO / VIDEO / DOCUMENT) is dropped; Gemini prices audio input above text and OpenAI's prompt_tokens_details.audio_tokens has a slot for it, so audio prompts are costed as text
